meta.pageTitle: Chapter 6: Laser and Plasma — Interactive Physics Book
meta.description: Chapter Six of the Interactive Physics Book: Laser and Plasma — the laser and maser, properties of laser beams, the working principles of laser, laser device components, laser level systems, types of laser, applications of laser, plasma and its applications — with interactive tools and solved questions.
meta.footer: Chapter Six: Laser and Plasma — Interactive Physics Book

hero.eyebrow: 📘 Interactive Physics Book · Third Grade · Industrial Track
hero.lead: From Einstein's theory of stimulated emission to the first working laser device, from the components of a laser device and its level systems to its types and wide-ranging applications, all the way to the fourth state of matter: plasma and its applications.

objectivesLead: After studying this chapter, the student should be able to:
objectives: Know the laser and the maser.
Distinguish between spontaneous emission and stimulated emission.
Identify the concepts of (the active medium, the resonator, the pumping technique).

lessons.title: Laser and Maser
lessons.description: 6-1: The origin of the name, Einstein's theory, Townes's maser, Maiman's laser.

lessons.title: Properties of Laser Beams
lessons.description: 6-2: Monochromaticity, directionality, coherence, brightness, with a solved example.

lessons.title: The Foundation of Laser Working
lessons.description: 6-3: Stimulated absorption, spontaneous and stimulated emission, population inversion.

lessons.title: Constituents of Laser Devices
lessons.description: 6-4: The active medium, the resonator, the pumping technique.

lessons.title: Laser Level Systems
lessons.description: 6-5: The three-level system and the four-level system.

lessons.title: Types of Laser
lessons.description: 6-6: Solid-state and gas lasers, the semiconductor laser, and more.

lessons.title: Some Applications of Laser
lessons.description: 6-7: Industrial, medical, scientific, communications applications, and more.

lessons.title: Plasma
lessons.description: 6-8: The fourth state of matter, ionization factors, plasma in the universe.

lessons.title: Some Applications of Plasma
lessons.description: 6-9: Display screens, lamps, nuclear fusion, and more.

lessons.title: Chapter Six Questions
lessons.description: All seven end-of-chapter questions, solved in detail.
